### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Stop node-build flakes from jest worker oversubscription](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3045) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The `node-build` job runs ESLint and the build with 2 threads and Jest with 4 workers, so `Verify` no longer runs out of memory and kills its Postgres container. Two heavy render tests get a 20-second timeout.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.7.0...v3.7.1
